075   /**
076    * Cleans up thread-local buffer caches for the current thread.
077    *
078    * <p>
079    * This method should be called when a thread is finished using the buffer caches to prevent memory leaks
080    * in thread pool environments where threads are reused.
081    */
082   public static void cleanupThreadLocals() {
083      if (BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE != null) {
084         BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE.remove();
085      }
086      if (CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE != null) {
087         CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE.remove();
088      }
089   }

110   /**
111    * Close all specified input streams, output streams, readers, and writers.
112    *
113    * @param o
114    *    The list of all objects to close.
115    *    <jk>null</jk> entries are ignored.
116    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
117    */
118   @SuppressWarnings({
119      "null" // Null analysis not applicable to variadic close operations
120   })
121   public static void close(Object...o) throws IOException {
122      IOException ex = null;
123      for (var o2 : o) {
124         try {
125            if (o2 instanceof InputStream o3)
126               o3.close();
127            if (o2 instanceof OutputStream o3)
128               o3.close();
129            if (o2 instanceof Reader o3)
130               o3.close();
131            if (o2 instanceof Writer o3)
132               o3.close();
133         } catch (IOException e) {
134            ex = e;
135         }
136      }
137      if (isNotNull(ex))
138         throw ex;
139   }

211   /**
212    * Counts the number of bytes in the input stream and then closes the stream.
213    *
214    * @param is The input stream to read from.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
215    * @return The number of bytes read.
216    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
217    */
218   public static long count(InputStream is) throws IOException {
219      if (is == null)
220         return 0;
221      var c = 0l;
222      var i = 0l;
223      try {
224         while ((i = is.skip(1024)) != 0)
225            c += i;
226      } finally {
227         is.close();
228      }
229      return c;
230   }
231
232   /**
233    * Counts the number of characters in the reader and then closes the reader.
234    *
235    * @param r The reader to read from.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
236    * @return The number of characters read.
237    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
238    */
239   public static long count(Reader r) throws IOException {
240      if (r == null)
241         return 0;
242      var c = 0l;
243      var i = 0l;
244      try {
245         while ((i = r.skip(1024)) != 0)
246            c += i;
247      } finally {
248         r.close();
249      }
250      return c;
251   }

253   /**
254    * Flushes multiple output streams and writers in a single call.
255    *
256    * @param o
257    *    The objects to flush.
258    *    <jk>null</jk> entries are ignored.
259    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
260    */
261   @SuppressWarnings({
262      "null" // Null analysis not applicable to variadic flush operations
263   })
264   public static void flush(Object...o) throws IOException {
265      IOException ex = null;
266      for (var o2 : o) {
267         try {
268            if (o2 instanceof OutputStream o3)
269               o3.flush();
270            if (o2 instanceof Writer o3)
271               o3.flush();
272         } catch (IOException e) {
273            ex = e;
274         }
275      }
276      if (isNotNull(ex))
277         throw ex;
278   }

280   /**
281    * Loads a text file from either the file system or classpath.
282    *
283    * @param name The file name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
284    * @param paths The paths to search.
285    * @return The file contents, or <jk>null</jk> if not found.
286    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
287    */
288   public static String loadSystemResourceAsString(String name, String...paths) throws IOException {
289      for (var path : paths) {
290         var p = new File(path);
291         if (p.exists()) {
292            var f = new File(p, name);
293            if (f.exists() && f.canRead())
294               return read(f);
295         }
296      }
297      var cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
298      if (cl == null)
299         cl = ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader();
300      for (var path : paths) {
301         var n = ".".equals(path) ? name : path + '/' + name;
302         try (var is = cl.getResourceAsStream(n)) {
303            if (isNotNull(is))
304               return read(is);
305         }
306         try (var is = ClassLoader.getSystemResourceAsStream(n)) {
307            if (isNotNull(is))
308               return read(is);
309         }
310      }
311      return null;
312   }
313
314   /**
315    * Pipes the contents of the specified <c>Reader</c> to the specified <c>Writer</c> a line at a time.
316    *
317    * <p>
318    * Writer is flushed after every line.  Typically useful when writing to consoles.
319    *
320    * @param in
321    *    The reader to pipe from.
322    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
323    *    <br>Reader is automatically closed.
324    * @param out
325    *    The file to write the output to.
326    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
327    *    <br>Writer is flushed but not automatically closed.
328    * @return
329    *    The number of characters piped.
330    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
331    */
332   public static long pipeLines(Reader in, Writer out) throws IOException {
333      if (in == null || out == null)
334         return 0;
335      var total = 0l;
336      try (var in2 = in) {
337         try (var s = new Scanner(in2)) {
338            while (s.hasNextLine()) {
339               var l = s.nextLine();
340               if (isNotNull(l)) {
341                  out.write(l);
342                  out.write("\n");
343                  out.flush();
344                  total += l.length() + 1;
345               }
346            }
347         }
348      }
349      return total;
350   }

547   /**
548    * Pipes the specified object to the specified output stream.
549    *
550    * @param in
551    *    The input byte array.
552    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> or any of the following types:
553    *    <ul>
554    *       <li>{@link Reader}
555    *       <li>{@link InputStream}
556    *       <li>{@link File}
557    *       <li>byte array.
558    *    </ul>
559    * @return The input converted to a string, or <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
560    * @throws IOException If thrown from output stream.
561    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the input is non-<jk>null</jk> but not one of the supported types.
562    */
563   public static String read(Object in) throws IOException {
564      if (in == null)
565         return null;
566      if (in instanceof Reader in2)
567         return read(in2);
568      if (in instanceof InputStream in2)
569         return read(in2);
570      if (in instanceof File in2)
571         return read(in2);
572      if (in instanceof byte[] in2)
573         return read(in2);
574      throw iaex("Invalid type passed to read:  %s", ClassUtils.className(in));
575   }

637   /**
638    * Reads the specified input into a {@link String} until the end of the input is reached.
639    *
640    * @param in
641    *    The input reader.
642    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk>.
643    *    <br>String is automatically closed.
644    * @param expectedLength
645    *    Specify a positive number if the length of the input is known, or <c>-1</c> if unknown.
646    * @return
647    *    The contents of the reader as a string, or <jk>null</jk> if the reader was <jk>null</jk>.
648    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred trying to read from the reader.
649    */
650   public static String read(Reader in, long expectedLength) throws IOException {
651      if (in == null)
652         return null;
653      try (var in2 = in) {
654         var sb = new StringBuilder(buffSize(expectedLength)); // Assume they're ASCII characters.
655         var buf = charBuffer((int)expectedLength);
656         var i = 0;
657         while ((i = in2.read(buf)) != -1)
658            sb.append(buf, 0, i);
659         return sb.toString();
660      }
661   }

700    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns an empty array).
701    *    <br>Stream is automatically closed.
702    * @return A byte array containing the contents.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
703    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
704    */
705   public static byte[] readBytes(InputStream in) throws IOException {
706      try (var in2 = in) {
707         return readBytes(in2, -1);
708      }
709   }

711   /**
712    * Reads the specified input stream into the specified byte array.
713    *
714    * @param in
715    *    The input stream to read.
716    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns an empty array).
717    *    <br>Stream is not automatically closed.
718    * @param maxBytes
719    *    The maximum number of bytes or <c>-1</c> to read the entire stream.
720    * @return A byte array containing the contents.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
721    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
722    */
723   public static byte[] readBytes(InputStream in, int maxBytes) throws IOException {
724      if (in == null)
725         return new byte[0];
726      var buff = new ByteArrayOutputStream(buffSize(maxBytes));
727      var nRead = 0;
728      var b = byteBuffer(maxBytes);
729      while ((nRead = in.read(b, 0, b.length)) != -1)
730         buff.write(b, 0, nRead);
731      buff.flush();
732      return buff.toByteArray();
733   }

753   /**
754    * Inflates (decompresses) the specified compressed bytes with a hard ceiling on the total output size and an
755    * effective output-to-input ratio guard.
756    *
757    * <p>
758    * Building on the bounded-copy family in this class (such as {@link #readBytes(InputStream,int)} and
759    * {@link #pipe(InputStream,OutputStream,long)}), this method decompresses untrusted input without letting a
760    * small compressed payload expand into an unbounded allocation.  Two independent limits are enforced
761    * <i>during</i> inflation, so a violating stream is aborted before its full output is ever materialized:
762    * <ul>
763    *    <li><b>Absolute cap.</b> If the running output size would exceed <jv>maxOutputBytes</jv>, an
764    *       {@link IOException} is thrown.
765    *    <li><b>Ratio guard.</b> If the running output size would exceed <jv>maxRatio</jv> times the compressed
766    *       input length, an {@link IOException} is thrown &mdash; this catches a highly-compressible payload even
767    *       when the absolute cap is generous.
768    * </ul>
769    *
770    * @param compressed
771    *    The compressed input bytes.
772    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns an empty array).
773    * @param nowrap
774    *    Pass <jk>true</jk> for a raw (headerless) DEFLATE stream, or <jk>false</jk> for a zlib-wrapped stream.
775    *    <br>Must match the format used to compress the input.
776    * @param maxOutputBytes
777    *    The maximum number of decompressed bytes to allow.
778    *    <br>Values <c>&lt;= 0</c> disable the absolute cap (mirroring the <c>maxLength</c> convention used
779    *    elsewhere); the ratio guard, if enabled, still applies.
780    * @param maxRatio
781    *    The maximum allowed ratio of output size to compressed input size.
782    *    <br>Values <c>&lt;= 0</c> disable the ratio guard.
783    * @return The decompressed bytes.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
784    * @throws IOException
785    *    If the input is not valid for the selected format, or if either the absolute cap or the ratio guard is
786    *    exceeded.
787    * @since 10.0.0
788    */
789   public static byte[] inflate(byte[] compressed, boolean nowrap, long maxOutputBytes, int maxRatio) throws IOException {
790      if (compressed == null || compressed.length == 0)
791         return new byte[0];
792      var cap = maxOutputBytes <= 0 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : maxOutputBytes;
793      var ratioLimit = maxRatio <= 0 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : (long)compressed.length * maxRatio;
794      var inflater = new Inflater(nowrap);
795      // Inflater isn't AutoCloseable at this module's source/target level, so route end() through
796      // try-with-resources via a Closeable method reference (inflate() already declares throws IOException).
797      try (Closeable end = inflater::end) {
798         inflater.setInput(compressed);
799         return inflateAll(inflater, cap, ratioLimit, maxRatio);
800      }
801   }
802
803   private static byte[] inflateAll(Inflater inflater, long cap, long ratioLimit, int maxRatio) throws IOException {
804      var out = new ByteArrayOutputStream(BUFF_SIZE);
805      var buf = new byte[BUFF_SIZE];
806      var total = 0L;
807      while (true) {
808         var n = inflateChunk(inflater, buf);
809         if (n > 0) {
810            total += n;
811            checkInflateLimits(total, cap, ratioLimit, maxRatio);
812            out.write(buf, 0, n);
813         } else if (inflater.finished() || inflater.needsDictionary() || inflater.needsInput()) {
814            break;
815         }
816      }
817      return out.toByteArray();
818   }
819
820   private static int inflateChunk(Inflater inflater, byte[] buf) throws IOException {
821      try {
822         return inflater.inflate(buf);
823      } catch (DataFormatException e) {
824         throw ioex(e, "Invalid compressed data");
825      }
826   }
827
828   private static void checkInflateLimits(long total, long cap, long ratioLimit, int maxRatio) throws IOException {
829      if (total > cap)
830         throw ioex("Inflated output exceeds maximum allowed %s bytes", cap);
831      if (total > ratioLimit)
832         throw ioex("Inflated output-to-input ratio exceeds maximum allowed %s", maxRatio);
833   }

835   /**
836    * Wraps the specified reader in a buffered reader.
837    *
838    * @param r The reader being wrapped.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
839    * @return
840    *    The reader wrapped in a {@link BufferedReader}, or the original {@link Reader} if it's already a buffered
841    *    reader, or <jk>null</jk> if the argument was <jk>null</jk>.
842    */
843   @SuppressWarnings({
844      "resource" // Caller takes ownership of the returned Reader
845   })
846   public static Reader toBufferedReader(Reader r) {
847      if (r == null || r instanceof BufferedReader || r instanceof StringReader)
848         return r;
849      return new BufferedReader(r);
850   }
851
852   private static int buffSize(long max) {
853      return (max > 0 && max < BUFF_SIZE) ? (int)max : BUFF_SIZE;
854   }
855
856   private static byte[] byteBuffer(int maxBytes) {
857      if (isNotNull(BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE)) {
858         var x = BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE.get();
859         if (x == null) {
860            x = new byte[BUFF_SIZE];
861            BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE.set(x);
862            BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE_MISSES.incrementAndGet();
863         } else {
864            BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE_HITS.incrementAndGet();
865         }
866         return x;
867      }
868      return new byte[buffSize(maxBytes)];
869   }
870
871   private static char[] charBuffer(int maxChars) {
872      if (isNotNull(CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE)) {
873         var x = CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE.get();
874         if (x == null) {
875            x = new char[BUFF_SIZE];
876            CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE.set(x);
877            CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE_MISSES.incrementAndGet();
878         } else {
879            CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE_HITS.incrementAndGet();
880         }
881         return x;
882      }
883      return new char[buffSize(maxChars)];
884   }

890   /** Pipes bytes to output stream.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
891   public static long pipe(byte[] in, OutputStream out, int maxBytes) throws IOException {
892      if (in == null || out == null)
893         return 0;
894      var length = (maxBytes < 0 || maxBytes > in.length) ? in.length : maxBytes;
895      out.write(in, 0, length);
896      return length;
897   }
898
899   /** Pipes input stream to output stream.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
900   public static long pipe(InputStream in, OutputStream out) throws IOException {
901      try (var in2 = in) {
902         return pipe(in, out, -1L);
903      }
904   }
905
906   /** Pipes input stream to output stream with exception handler.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>.  <br><jv>onException</jv> must not be <jk>null</jk> (invoked on I/O error). */
907   public static long pipe(InputStream in, OutputStream out, Consumer<IOException> onException) {
908      try {
909         try (var in2 = in) {
910            return pipe(in, out, -1L);
911         }
912      } catch (IOException e) {
913         onException.accept(e);
914         return -1;
915      }
916   }
917
918   /** Pipes input stream to output stream with max bytes.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
919   public static long pipe(InputStream in, OutputStream out, long maxBytes) throws IOException {
920      if (in == null || out == null)
921         return 0;
922      var buffer = byteBuffer((int)maxBytes);
923      int readLen;
924      var total = 0l;
925      if (maxBytes < 0) {
926         while ((readLen = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
927            out.write(buffer, 0, readLen);
928            total += readLen;
929         }
930      } else {
931         var remaining = maxBytes;
932         while (remaining > 0) {
933            readLen = in.read(buffer, 0, buffSize(remaining));
934            if (readLen == -1)
935               break;
936            out.write(buffer, 0, readLen);
937            total += readLen;
938            remaining -= readLen;
939         }
940      }
941      out.flush();
942      return total;
943   }

945   /** Pipes input stream to writer.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
946   public static long pipe(InputStream in, Writer out) throws IOException {
947      if (in == null || out == null)
948         return 0;
949      return pipe(new InputStreamReader(in, UTF8), out);
950   }

952   /** Pipes input stream to writer with exception handler.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>.  <br><jv>onException</jv> must not be <jk>null</jk> (invoked on I/O error). */

964   /** Pipes reader to file.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */

973   /** Pipes reader to output stream.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
974   public static long pipe(Reader in, OutputStream out) throws IOException {
975      if (in == null || out == null)
976         return 0;
977      var total = 0l;
978      try (var in2 = in) {
979         var osw = new OutputStreamWriter(out, UTF8);
980         var i = 0;
981         var b = charBuffer(-1);
982         while ((i = in.read(b)) > 0) {
983            total += i;
984            osw.write(b, 0, i);
985         }
986         osw.flush();
987      }
988      return total;
989   }

1028   /**
1029    * Prints all the specified lines to the log with line numbers.
1030    *
1031    * @param lines The lines to print.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> (individual <jk>null</jk> entries render as <js>"null"</js>).
1032    */
1033   public static final void printLines(String[] lines) {
1034      Logger log = Logger.getLogger(IoUtils.class);
1035      for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++)
1036         log.info(String.format("%4s:%s", i + 1, lines[i]));
1037   }
